messages:
olivia_support: ACME (org: 5421) just reported the Token Cost tile in Console shows $0 / NaN for yesterday -> today. Customer spotted it at ~03:12 UTC, screenshot attached. Any immediate thoughts?
ben_engineering: Not seeing any runtime deploys at that window. Do we know which orgs are affected besides 5421?
olivia_support: I pulled a quick sample — orgs 5421, 6720, 7193. It seems isolated to the Cost -> Token breakdown widget; other billing pages look normal.
nilesh_data: Running a quick ledger -> pricing join to see if nulls are propagating. Posting query I ran:```sql
SELECT org_id, sum(tokens) as tok, sum(tokens * price) as total_cost, count(*) as rows
FROM usage u
LEFT JOIN model_prices p ON u.model_version = p.model_version AND date(u.ts) = p.date
WHERE org_id IN (5421,6720,7193) AND u.ts >= '2024-06-02'
GROUP BY org_id;
```
nilesh_data: Results look like model_prices.price IS NULL for rows between 02:58-03:10 UTC (FX ingest failed overnight). That causes the cost aggregation to produce 0/NaN for those orgs.
sara_ops: FYI the FX ingestion job errored on rate-limits at 02:50 UTC, I restarted it at 03:30 UTC and reprocess kicked off. See run: https://ci/reprocess/523 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
infra-bot: reprocess-job: triggered re-ingest for window 02:00-04:00 UTC by nilesh_data
ben_engineering: Short-term display fix: coalesce(price, 0) at the UI/API will stop NaNs showing to customers, but that hides the real missing pricing. We'll backfill ledger first, then ship a canary to coalesce in the presentation layer.
olivia_support: I'll tell the customer we've escalated and are running a backfill; ETA 2 hours. They flagged this as affecting billing visibility, so clarity + ETA needed.
nilesh_data: Backfill job progress: ~40% complete, no further errors so far. Expect aggregation/backfill to finish by ~05:15 UTC. If any org still shows $0 after backfill we'll re-run the aggregator and do a manual reconcile.
olivia_support: Thanks — please ping here when finished and include reconciliation steps so I can share with the customer. :thumbsup:
ben_engineering: Also opening a small PR to add coalesce on the cost tile as a defensive measure, will deploy canary in ~30m and monitor.
olivia_support: Copy. Leaving thread open until backfill + canary verified.
